description: Look at a PDF without changing it: page count, page ids and sizes, encryption, and (with for_edit) every form field with its type, value and options. Free, and the right first step before edit_pdf. Docs: https://apidocs.podpdf.com/api-reference/pdf-editor

file.description: A PDF: a path on this machine, e.g. "./contract.pdf", or an https:// link to one

for_edit.description: true also returns page ids for recipes and the form field survey (needs the editor on your plan)

name: inspect_pdf
title: Inspect PDF
